They offer to buy a replacement that would remain their property and be taken with them on leaving. Please confirm whether the machine is yours, and how you'd like to proceed.
options: Send our contractor to diagnose the existing machine (recommended, to confirm it is beyond repair)
You arrange your own contractor or replacement

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. As the machine was in the flat when you moved in, we need to check with your landlord first, both about whether it is theirs to repair or replace, and whether they consent to you fitting your own, which would stay yours. We've asked them and will update you by 30 July. Please don't dispose of the old machine meanwhile. If you can, send a photo of it and any error code, as that will help.
